svg.title: How long each request to a running actor took during the three outages
svg.desc: Three panels plot the seconds until the answer for every request to the running actor e-run, one request each second. Without Postgres, each failed request took 9.0 seconds, the client timeout, and the requests that were open when Postgres returned got a 500. Without ate-api-server, each failed request got a 503 after at most 5.02 seconds. Without the Kubernetes API server, every request returned 200 in about 0.03 seconds.
